## Operator ruling (2026-08-21): reclassify to a design/doc task (bug -> task)

The operator approved reclassifying this ticket as a **design/documentation task**: both concrete residuals it records are documented-intended behaviour per `docs/concurrency.md` §I4a (and residual 1 is pinned as deliberate by `test_claim_transition_parent_cascade.py::test_reactivate_does_not_disturb_open_parent`, matching minnow's AC2). What remains is reconciliation work, not a defect repair: the over-broad §I4a headline sentence ("A child never runs ahead of its parent in the lifecycle") must be narrowed to what the cascade table actually guarantees, and the `blocked -> in_progress` disagreement between the start-work gate (which fires on that edge) and the cascade table (which omits it) must be resolved one way or the other in the table/docs.

**Related operator ruling recorded here so it is not lost:** the operator has also ruled that "rebar should maintain as an invariant that no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket." Any redesign of the cascade table / §I4a wording done under this ticket must treat that as a required invariant, not an open question. That ruling bears on the same parent/child lifecycle surface as bug bb73-97de (`despotic-prime-reindeer`, inbound reconcile writes STATUS directly, bypassing the parent-first cascade) — linked `relates_to` accordingly.

Type changed bug -> task; the residual analysis and ACs are unchanged; status stays open.
